Both answers explain that TCR recognition of peptide plus self MHC is not enough for naive T-cell activation and that professional-APC costimulation is needed. B more explicitly connects missing costimulation to not becoming activated, proliferating, and differentiating, while A is slightly more wordy.

Both answers satisfy the checklist and avoid the forbidden inference. B is a little more precise about the source boundary by repeatedly anchoring the rule to naive T cells and professional APC costimulation, with a tighter explanation of what fails when costimulation is absent.
